items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: explain how I got Pharaoh Sanders on my label

ctx.x: Well let me suggest that maybe you could do a part two with Christian and continue some of those questions which I know that I couldn’t answer so I’d have to leave it up to you.
All right. Well if you guys want to continue fine. There’s nothing I’m really dying to say other than explain how I got Pharaoh Sanders on my label. Do you have time for that now or no?
We’d like to hear that, yes.
